notes.title: EA version features added and updated
notes.notes:
[b]Many bug fixes and detail adjustments[/b]
Waiting for your experience and feedback.

[b]Fix the xbox controller issues[/b]
The gamepad library has been changed to solve the problem that the gamepad cannot be moved by default config in Steam. And the vibration effect is added.

[b]Adjust the drop system[/b]
According to players' suggestions, equipment will drop directly into the scene. And high-quality equipment will light up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050264/3ec6756776d70385b946c8018608f34fb4c3fee0.png[/img]

[b]Add achievement system[/b]
Added 9 steam achievements and will continue to add as the game content increases.

[b]Online PVP System [/b]
The real gameplay of Mulite Swordsman is now unlocked!
Note: PVP system are still in testing. You may encounter problems such as unstable connections, unsynchronized characters, and some skills will not work. Feedback is welcome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36050264/2e1896f43363408f4728d77c3c74c25485141e8e.jpg[/img]

How to play in PVP:
1) Talk to the NPC in the bottom right corner of the camp, or press "Ctrl + N" to enter the battle lobby.
2) Please complete the skill points before fighting.
3) Create game and wait for players or search game to join.

How to play against your friends:
1) Create a game
2) Call out the Steam Friends interface (shift + tab), right-click the friend's avatar, and select "Invite to lobby".
3) Wait for your friend to enter the lobby and accept the steam invitation.


[b] What to do next [/b]
1) More levels, monsters, tasks, skills and equipment, this will be a huge workload and a continuous goal.
2) Improve the PVP system.
3) Professional English translation, adding more language support.
4) Improve UI system.
